common.tagline: All your policies in one place

meta.title: InsurWallet — All your policies in one place
meta.description: Centralize your insurance, upload documents with AI, and ask MarIAna.

landing.heroTitle: Understand your insurance without the hassle
landing.heroSubtitle: Centralize policies, upload documents with AI, and ask MarIAna when you need help.
landing.floatingCardDesc: Review every field before saving your policy.
landing.trustTitle: Focused on clarity, we earn your trust
landing.trustDesc: Your policies are sensitive data. InsurWallet prioritizes privacy, human review before saving, and an assistant that explains without replacing your insurer.
landing.feature1Desc: Life, health, auto, home and more in one dashboard.
landing.feature2Desc: Upload your PDF and review extracted data before saving.
landing.feature3Desc: Ask about coverages, renewals, or who to call in emergencies.
landing.feature4Desc: Get notified before renewals and avoid coverage gaps.
landing.feature5Desc: Secure links with permissions and expiration dates.
landing.feature6Desc: Every extracted field shows its confidence level before you confirm.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to understand your insurance
landing.featuresSubtitle: Centralize, extract, and ask — without losing control of your policies.
landing.featuresSectionTitle: Quality and control at every step of your portfolio
landing.featuresSectionSubtitle: Built for policy owners in LATAM — clear, secure, and free of unnecessary jargon.
landing.servicesTitle: Trusted workflows for every insurance need
landing.service1Desc: Upload your policy PDF and track status in real time.
landing.service2Desc: Confirm coverages, premiums, and dates before saving.
landing.service3Desc: See which policies renew soon and act in time.
landing.service4Desc: Ask in plain language with citations to your documents.
landing.productVisualPrompt: What does my travel policy cover?
landing.testimonialSectionTitle: How we help you understand insurance, clearly
landing.testimonialQuote: I used to keep policies in emails and folders. With InsurWallet I uploaded my PDFs, reviewed the data, and MarIAna explained my health coverage before a trip.
landing.footerCtaTitle: It's time to take control of your insurance
landing.footerCtaBenefit1: Free account with email or Google
landing.footerCtaDesc: Get started in minutes. No credit card required to explore the dashboard.
